name: evalroom sample pack (Gate E): the bin from above with its five pieces of rubbish, the inside of the hat, the small key. Level file levels/LEVEL-evalroom.md, Gates A to D signed 22 to 24 Oct 2026.
notes: Judged in the live room on the tablet, never as loose files (CLAUDE.md gate E). A failed sample goes back to its prompt, not to the batch.
Cut-outs are keyed on white, cropped and quantised with tools/lift.py's method; close-ups saved at 1920x1080 JPEG 88.

cases.prompt:
Style: a polished, finished illustration drawn for a game, not a picture book for toddlers; clean dark-ink outlines on everything, a shadow side on every object and soft cast shadows from one light source, so things sit solidly on their surfaces; smooth colour with gentle shading, a faint paper-grain texture and a gentle vignette at the edges. Bright and clear, not hazy or dark. The attached picture is a crop from the room this belongs to: copy only its style, hand and palette, not its objects. Palette of the room: cream walls over a pale mint band, pale wood floor, teal and purple accents, warm afternoon sun. A single picture that fills the whole 16:9 frame edge to edge: no border, no margin, no frame, no dark surround. No words, letters, numbers or symbols anywhere in the picture.

The picture: looking straight down into a green plastic recycling bin from directly above, its square rim with rounded corners filling the frame almost to the edges, the inside walls a darker green sloping down to the flat bottom, which is empty but for a little paper dust and one faint scuff. The white recycling symbol on the inside wall is just visible, foreshortened. Soft light from the upper left, the far inside walls in shadow. Nothing in the bin, nothing written anywhere.
cases.note: asset 12, the bin from above; the five rubbish pieces are laid on it by the game
